what_the_leaf_means: The rotation receipt produced by the derived-order resolver. Per data/worklists/f2-task.md the /api/calculate response carries a 'rotation' receipt ({order, rationale}); per data/worklists/f3-task.md the resolver detects 'setup/consume edges' — an ability that APPLIES something must precede the abilities that CONSUME it — and the invariant suite asserts 'the derived order never violates a detected setup/consume edge'. `rotation/setup` is therefore the list of setup-side ability slots for the scenario's champion; setup[1] is a second entry in that list.

independent_computation.question: For Syndra, which ability slot(s) are legitimately setup-side, and is 'Q' a sourced value for a second setup entry?

step_1_enumerate_syndra_kit_from_cached_.Q Dark Sphere: 'Syndra conjures a Dark Sphere at the target location ... The Dark Sphere then remains on the ground for 6 seconds.' -> the ONLY ability that PLACES a persistent Dark Sphere object. Transcendent bonus: 'Collecting 40 Splinters of Wrath causes Syndra to periodically stock a Dark Sphere charge, up to a maximum of 2.' -> two Q casts are legal back-to-back.
step_1_enumerate_syndra_kit_from_cached_.W Force of Will: 'Syndra telekinetically grabs the nearest Dark Sphere, enemy minion or non-epic monster ...' -> CONSUMER of a pre-existing sphere (in a champion-vs-champion fight with no minion/monster in the model, the sphere is the only grabbable target).
step_1_enumerate_syndra_kit_from_cached_.E Scatter the Weak: 'Dark Spheres can be knocked back for 950 units ... Targets hit are also stunned for 1.25 seconds ... and dealt Scatter the Weak's damage if they were not damaged by the initial cast.' -> CONSUMER: the sphere-carried second damage instance and the stun exist only if a Dark Sphere is already on the ground.
step_1_enumerate_syndra_kit_from_cached_.R Unleashed Power: 'Syndra conjures 3 Dark Spheres and additionally grabs up to 4 nearby live ones.' -> CONSUMER of up to 4 PRE-EXISTING spheres.
step_1_enumerate_syndra_kit_from_cached_.P Transcendent: Splinters of Wrath — a passive stack counter gained from damage instances / rank-ups / large minions. NOT applied by any single ability, so it creates no ability-to-ability setup edge.

step_2_arithmetic_proof_that_R_consumes_.rows_quoted: R leveling rows: 'Magic Damage per Sphere' = 80/120/160 (+20% AP); 'Minimum Magic Damage' = 240/360/480 (+60% AP); 'Maximum Magic Damage' = 560/840/1120 (+140% AP).
step_2_arithmetic_proof_that_R_consumes_.conclusion: R spans exactly 3 -> 7 spheres. The 3 are self-conjured; the additional 4 must be live spheres already on the ground, i.e. prior Q casts. R's damage is therefore strictly increasing in the number of Q setup casts, up to 4.

step_3_consistency_check_of_the_cached_p.W true-damage rows: 'Bonus True Damage' 8.4/12/15.6/19.2/22.8 vs W base 70/100/130/160/190 -> ratio exactly 0.12 at every rank, matching the prose 'enhances Force of Will to deal 12% (+ 2% per 100 AP) bonus true damage'; 'Total Mixed Damage' 78.4/112/145.6/179.2/212.8 = base + true. The cached Syndra parse is internally consistent, so the rows quoted above are trustworthy.
step_3_consistency_check_of_the_cached_p.note: W's and E's Transcendent bonuses are gated on Splinter COUNT (60 / 80), not on a debuff applied by another ability — so they create no setup edge of their own.

independent_computation.step_4_edge_set: Setup/consume edges sourced from the cached wiki text: Q -> W (grab), Q -> E (sphere knockback + stun + second damage instance), Q -> R (up to 4 live spheres). Q is the UNIQUE setup-side slot in Syndra's kit; W, E and R are all consumers. No other slot can legitimately occupy any index of Syndra's setup list.
independent_computation.step_5_multiplicity: There is more than one distinct Q-fed consume edge (three), and the consumers demand more than one live sphere simultaneously (W holds one, E knocks one, R collects up to four). Syndra's own kit permits multiple setup casts: the 40-Splinter Transcendent bonus stocks 'a maximum of 2' Dark Sphere charges, and the audit records the module's modeled slots as P, Q, Q2, W, E, R with 'Q2 (2nd charge)' and 'ammo (Q 2nd charge at 40 splinters)' (data/champion-audit/batch-6.json). A setup list of length >= 2 for Syndra is therefore sourced, and every element of it must be the Dark Sphere slot.
independent_computation.result: setup[1] = "Q" is the only value consistent with the cached wiki text; an absent second setup entry understates a kit with three distinct Q-fed consume edges and a rank-invariant 3->7 sphere span on R.

residual_uncertainty: The golden file itself was deliberately not read, so the value at setup[0] and the exact list semantics (deduped slot set vs. one entry per detected edge vs. ordered setup-cast prefix) were not observed. This does not change the verdict: under every one of those readings the only slot Syndra can contribute to a setup list is her Dark Sphere slot. The one alternative spelling worth flagging is the module's synthetic second-charge slot name 'Q2' — if the resolver enumerated setup CASTS by module slot key rather than by ability slot, a second entry could arguably read 'Q2'. Nothing in the cached data indicates the rotation receipt uses module-internal synthetic slot keys (f2-task.md shows the receipt order as [Q,E,E,E,...], i.e. real ability letters), so 'Q' remains the sourced value.
verdict_detail: new_value_correct — Q (Dark Sphere) is the unique setup-side ability in Syndra's kit; W, E and R every one of them consume a pre-placed Dark Sphere, and R's rows prove a 3->7 sphere span requiring up to 4 pre-placed Q spheres. A second setup entry of 'Q' is sourced; its previous absence was an undercount.
